Rider explained no firm instructions other than to ride for luck as stable believs races best this way and rather than making wide run from 600m shifted inwards.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Not pushed early & raced keenly behind Mid Field Two Wide (5L from lead). Held Ground until pushed out 3 Wide @ 450m. Pushed along 3 Wide @ 400m & chasing Five Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 300m & raced tight @ 150m. Held ground late. # Margin unfair.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages and passing the 800m was eased when momentarily crowded for room. Near the 400m was eased when briefly crowded for room. Passing the 50m was eased when crowded for room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out Settled Down rear 6l Two Wide home turn 5l Held Up 500-200 badly held up Going Well finally got to Outside Middle Of Track flashed home, 3l to 3rd Ride queried 600 # luckless/flew
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Held up for clear running from the 500m until approaching the 200m. When questioned regarding her riding from the 600m, rider explained she was initially trailing a runner she thought would take her into the race. She added from the 600m she didn’t shift out to follow the favourite as that mare wasn’t travelling well and she didn’t want to be caught wide rounding the home turn. They further added when that runner was not taking her into the race, she then elected to move to the outside approaching the 200m to obtain clear running
